endorsements.quote: (1) governance and accountability: establish an oversight committee, maintain a public registry of AI systems, and require predeployment Algorithmic Impact Assessments and Data Protection Impact Assessments;

(4) privacy-preserving data governance: prohibit uploading PHI to public models; enforce data minimization and deidentification, role-based access controls, secure logging, and retention limits; and prefer on-prem and virtual private cloud solutions when processing student data;

(5) equity, safety, and robustness: conduct subgroup bias testing and disparate impact monitoring, pursue cross-site validation where feasible, and set predefined error thresholds with rollback plans.

To operationalize these pillars, we propose a staged pathway that begins with pilots in controlled sandbox environments with Algorithmic Impact Assessments or Data Protection Impact Assessments and a clear evaluation plan, then scales gradually with bias and robustness audits and cross-site performance monitoring, and culminates in institutional integration with periodic audits, update protocols, and public reporting.
(2) human oversight in high-stakes uses: mandate dual human+AI scoring, structured debriefs, and explicit override criteria grounded in clinical or educational judgment;
(3) transparency: disclose in syllabi which tools are used and for what purposes and limits, provide model or data cards, and require student disclosure of AI assistance;

Cross-sector collaboration among educational institutions, technology developers, and researchers is crucial to establishing universal digital literacy standards that equip learners and faculty to critically evaluate AI-generated content and apply such tools responsibly in clinical and educational settings [ 4 ].

unlisted_practices: Report every AI pilot in education using a FACETS-aligned template to ensure transparency and comparability.
Integrate AI literacy into medical curricula without displacing foundational clinical skills.
Conduct predeployment audits for bias, drift, and adversarial robustness before scaling AI.
Deploy learning analytics dashboards tied to competency frameworks with ongoing psychometric monitoring.
Support longitudinal research on the educational and clinical impacts of AI integration.
Design low-cost, adaptable AI tools to promote equitable access in resource-limited settings.
Train AI systems on peer-reviewed, high-quality data and subject outputs to expert review.

screen.reason: Viewpoint article proposing strategic frameworks (FACETS) and governance recommendations for the responsible integration of AI in medical education.
